objectives.statement: Get the 500-checks-before-7am purity claim verified in the Telugu and English press before the paid work asks anyone to switch
objectives.proof: The checkpoint count is auditable at the plant: 500 dairy professionals, named shifts, daily QC log.

messages.text: 500 dairy professionals check Heritage milk every single day, before 7am.
messages.proof: Every morning, the milk is chosen fresh from good farmers and quality-checked before it reaches her door — so the start she gives her family is never left to chance.

messages.text: The milk is chosen fresh from named farmers each morning and quality-checked before it reaches a doorstep.
messages.proof: 500 dairy professionals check the milk every single day — purity here is people doing a job, not a slogan.

release.headline: Heritage Foods publishes its daily 7am quality log
release.lead_text: Heritage Foods said on Tuesday that the quality checks completed on every collection before 7am each morning are now published as a daily log for home-delivery subscribers across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
release.support: 500 dairy professionals complete the checks daily; the log records shift, checkpoint and time.
release.quote: A mother should not have to take our word for it. The log is what 500 people did before her morning started.
release.boilerplate: Heritage Foods is an Indian dairy company operating across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, sourcing from farmer suppliers and distributing packaged milk and value-added dairy.
release.contact: [press contact name, phone and email to be filled by the company]
